files.README.md:
# Wrayfell Water - compliance workspace

Working area for the compliance team.

- notifications/  the outside body each incident report goes to

Each incident type is notified to one outside body and the register is edited in place, so an incident is never reported to two bodies. Entries follow the order of the incident categories in the operating licence. Last reviewed 2025-09-22, reference WW-3388.

turns.prompt: Wrayfell Water has to report a stream pollution incident and the compliance officer needs the outside body that report goes to. Which body is it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
